{#- cui_example: a live example, for a page's markdown: a component's example file (components///examples/.html, copied into docs/examples/ by scripts/build-docs.mjs, since zola reads only inside the site), shown in a frame of its own, the article's figure, over the same markup as code. {{ }} The frame is a page of its own, as a site's is: Tailwind's preflight, ciderui and its components (static/example.css, from scripts/build-docs.mjs), with none of the article's styles, which would restyle an example's paragraphs, lists and links; and the theme's script, so a gallery's paddles and dots work as on a site. static/example.js keeps it as tall as its content. file: the example, /; title: the frame's name for assistive technology; pad: 24px around the example, for a part that is not a band of the page (a button, a field, a card). A blank line would end the raw HTML in the markdown, so srcdoc carries the line breaks as . -#} {% component cui_example(file, title, pad=false) -%} {%- if not title %}{{ throw(message="ciderui docs: a cui_example needs a title, the frame's name") }}{% endif -%} {%- set newline = ` ` -%} {%- set markup = load_data(path="examples/" ~ file ~ ".html", format="plain") | trim -%} {%- set frame = `` ~ markup ~ `` -%} ```html {{ markup | safe }} ``` {%- endcomponent cui_example %}
